name: Gogia Capital Growth Limited
summary: Gogia Capital Growth Limited, an Indian firm established in New Delhi in 1994, specializes in delivering extensive stock and commodity brokerage services to both corporate clients and individual investors. The company's comprehensive suite of offerings encompasses online initial public offering (IPO) access, back-office support, Know Your Customer (KYC) and account setup services, and sophisticated trading platforms, complemented by various analytical tools and a margin calculator. It further facilitates trading across diverse financial segments, including equities, currencies, commodities, derivatives, and intraday markets. Additionally, the company provides mutual funds, financial advisory, and depository services. Originally incorporated as Gogia Capital Services Limited, the firm officially adopted its current name, Gogia Capital Growth Limited, in September 2024.
